categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in five segments: Alumina (including bauxite mining, alumina production, and sales of alumina and related products), Primary Aluminum (including electrolytic aluminum production, carbon products, aluminum alloy, and other aluminum products), Energy (coal mining, thermal power, wind power, photovoltaic power, and new energy equipment manufacturing), Marketing (domestic and international sales and logistics services for alumina, aluminum, and other metals and raw materials), and Headquarters & Others (corporate management, R&D, and other activities).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies in bauxite mining, alumina refining, electrolytic aluminum production, and carbon product manufacturing. It emphasizes energy efficiency and green production methods, including the use of clean energy sources and digital transformation for smart manufacturing. The company also invests in R&D for energy-saving and carbon-reduction technologies, as well as high-purity aluminum and aluminum alloy development.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic electrolytic aluminum producers for alumina products, aluminum processing enterprises and distributors for primary aluminum products, and regional power grid companies for energy products. The company serves industries such as automotive, aerospace, construction, packaging, electronics, and new energy sectors like photovoltaics and electric vehicles, both domestically and internationally.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with significant assets and operations in provinces such as Shandong, Shanxi, Guangxi, Inner Mongolia, and Yunnan. It also has overseas operations, including bauxite mining and alumina production in Guinea and other countries. International sales and trading activities extend to global markets, with subsidiaries in Hong Kong and other regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: China Aluminum Corporation Limited is an integrated upstream and midstream player in the aluminum industry supply chain. It controls bauxite mining (upstream), alumina refining, electrolytic aluminum production (midstream), and also engages in downstream activities such as aluminum alloy production, carbon products, and logistics services. The company also operates in energy production to support its manufacturing processes.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes becoming a globally competitive, world-class aluminum enterprise with strengths in resource acquisition, technological innovation, advanced materials, and green low-carbon digital transformation. R&D focuses on energy-saving and carbon-reduction technologies, clean energy utilization, high-purity aluminum, aluminum alloy innovation, and digital manufacturing. It fosters collaboration with universities and research institutes and emphasizes patent development and technology commercialization.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of alumina, primary aluminum, aluminum alloy products, carbon products, and energy products. The company also earns income from logistics services, international trade, and technology licensing. Sales are conducted via long-term contracts, spot market transactions, and futures contracts, with pricing linked to market indices and negotiated agreements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in the global aluminum industry, holding the largest production capacities for alumina, primary aluminum, refined alumina, high-purity aluminum, aluminum anodes, and gallium metal worldwide. It competes with other major aluminum producers domestically and internationally, leveraging its integrated supply chain, resource base, technological innovation, and green production capabilities to maintain a strong market position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenues of approximately RMB 237 billion, representing a 5.21% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 12.4 billion, an 85.38% increase from the previous year. The company’s total assets stood at RMB 216 billion with a net asset value of RMB 69.2 billion, reflecting steady growth and improved profitability. Cash flow from operations increased by 21.37%, and the company maintained a healthy debt ratio of 48.10%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive and integrated aluminum industry chain, stable and abundant bauxite resources (both domestic and overseas), advanced technological capabilities, and commitment to green, low-carbon, and digital transformation. It differentiates itself through high production efficiency, product quality, innovation leadership, and strong market responsiveness, aiming to provide reliable supply and customized solutions to customers while promoting sustainable development.
